direction.comments: The direction is your generic horror teen movie drama, though it does build tension decently well considering the story is somewhat interesting

performance.comments: Plays her role decently well, but there does not feel like too much depth or range
Plays her role decently well; has decent chemistry with Keen

cast.comments: What you expect from a teen horror movie going straight to streaming; this does not count any child actors, but this movie is basically mid-20-year-olds acting like they're in high school

story.comments: The concept is somewhat interesting, but on a macro scale is pretty generic; the plot structure is your typical teen movie horror movie structure, but the epilogue was unnecessary; character writing is fine, I just didn't really care about these characters besides the lead because it's just templated characters

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is your typical teen horror movie dialogue; The humor is your typical teen horror movie dialogue; The symbolism is pretty shallow; The foreshadowing is somewhat present, but is also a bit predictable

visual_effects.comments: Felt a little tacky and of its budget

review.pacing: Pacing is fine but a little bit on the slower side; it could have shaved five minutes to make it tighter
review.climax: Climax is entertaining, but the epilogue was completely unnecessary and kind of ruined the movie
review.tone: Tone is very much like your low-budget teen horror movie
review.final_notes: Saw world premiere at Fantastic Fest
review.overall: Overall, it is very much your typical teen horror movie as it follows almost every trope to a tee, but it is still entertaining
